A 5% solution in water has a pH of 4.3 to 5.5. Store in airtight contain- ers. Protect from light. USP 31 (Isoproterenol Hydrochloride). A white to practically white, odourless, crystalline powder. It gradually darkens on ex- posure to air and light. Soluble 1 in 3 of water and 1 in 50 of al- cohol; less soluble in dehydrated alcohol; insoluble in chloro- form and in ether. A 1% solution in water has a pH of about 5. Solutions become pink to brownish-pink on standing exposed to air and almost immediately so when made alkaline. Store in air- tight containers.
